verdict.rationale: Quo publishes downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 documents for its Public API: a dated 2026-03-30 version linked from the docs pages, and a v1 spec linked from the docs llms.txt. The probe's 404s at guessed well-known paths on quo.com don't contradict this, since the files are served from an S3 bucket. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec download, and a spec served at a discoverable first-party well-known path (the S3 bucket still uses the legacy openphone name).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
